full_prompt_en: A square expressive portrait drawing places a man's head and upper neck against an almost white paper ground. His face tilts slightly upward, eyes looking above the viewer, mouth closed, and expression solemn. The head is largely bald, with a defined ear on the left and strong cheek, nose, and jaw planes. Instead of smooth natural skin color, the features are constructed from overlapping angular strokes in lemon yellow, warm orange, magenta, violet, turquoise, and deep navy. Fine black and gray sketch lines trace eyelids, nostrils, lips, and the edge of the jaw, while broad colored slashes and translucent washes cross the cheeks and forehead. Dark purples under the brows and across the neck anchor the vivid color, and bright white gaps remain exposed within the face. Loose straight construction lines, short dashed marks, and rectangular color fragments project outward around the head, particularly to the right, as though the portrait is still being assembled. Some lines extend well beyond the silhouette without becoming a detailed background. The lower neck dissolves into overlapping triangles and sharp bands rather than a finished torso. A small dark signature-like mark sits near the lower right, but its letters need not be legible. The whole image has visible pencil or ink texture, uneven pigment density, and a spontaneous hand-drawn energy. The head occupies the central portion while open white margins keep its complexity readable. The strongest contrasts gather around the eyes, nose, and mouth, so the fragmented color does not destroy likeness. The mood is searching and intense, combining observational anatomy with energetic abstraction.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性肖像绘画把男子的头和上颈放在近乎白色的纸面前。他的面孔略向上仰，双眼望向观者上方，嘴闭合，神情庄重。头部基本无发，左侧耳朵清楚可见，脸颊、鼻与下颌有鲜明结构。五官并非由平滑自然肤色塑成，而由柠檬黄、暖橙、洋红、紫罗兰、青绿与深海军蓝的重叠棱角笔画拼合。细黑灰素描线勾出眼皮、鼻孔、嘴唇与下颌边缘，宽阔彩色斜笔与透明色洗横越脸颊和前额。眉下与颈部的深紫压住明艳色彩，面部内部还留有明亮白色空隙。松散的直线结构稿、短虚线和矩形色彩碎片从头部四周向外伸展，尤其偏向右侧，仿佛肖像仍在组装。有些线远远越出轮廓，却不形成具体背景。下方脖颈化成重叠三角与尖锐色带，而非完成的躯干。右下附近有一处小深色签名般笔迹，但无须读清字母。整幅作品可见铅笔或墨线肌理、浓淡不一的颜料和自发的手绘能量。头部占据中部，四周开放白边使复杂线条仍可辨读。最强反差聚集于眼、鼻和嘴周围，因此碎裂色彩没有毁掉面貌。情绪探寻而强烈，把观察式解剖与活跃抽象结合。
style_prompt_en: Expressive mixed-media drawing builds recognizable volume from fast angular marks rather than blended paint. Fine graphite or ink contours secure key edges, while overlapping translucent swaths of yellow, orange, magenta, violet, cyan, and deep blue break the surface into lively facets. White paper remains visible through the color and forms generous margins around the central structure. Construction lines, dashed guides, and small rectangular interruptions can project beyond the main silhouette, giving the work an unfinished studio energy. Dense darks collect at focal contours and recessed planes; bright accents strike the ridges. Pigment opacity varies from dry scratch to broad wash, so the surface feels handled and layered. The composition holds anatomical clarity and abstraction in tension, with a sparse ground that lets every line and color collision register.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性混合媒介绘画以快速棱角线笔而非平滑晕染建立可辨体积。细石墨或墨线轮廓固定关键边缘，重叠的透明黄、橙、洋红、紫、青与深蓝色带则把表面分解成活跃切面。白纸从颜色中露出，并在中央结构周围形成宽裕边距。结构线、虚线辅助痕和小矩形断笔可伸出主体剪影，带来尚未收笔的画室能量。密集深色聚在焦点轮廓与凹处，明亮重音击中凸起面。颜料的不透明度从干涩刮线到宽色洗变化，使表面带有手工操作和层叠感。构图让解剖清晰度与抽象保持张力，稀疏底面使每道线和色彩相撞都清楚显现。
theme_en: An upward-looking face is assembled from colorful angular sketch marks
theme_zh: 一张仰望的面孔由彩色棱角线笔拼合而成
name: Hopare
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
